core_classes_note: Question is excluded from the core classifier: the M2 pilot found 1 example in 524. See docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md section 2.

classification.min_words_note: Issues shorter than this (title + body, after cleaning) go to manual review. Full-data M4: title-only input drops Macro-F1 from 0.80 to 0.45; live demo issues like 'Incorrect command in the setup.md file' (6 words).
classification.min_confidence_note: Set to 0.70 by the project owner after the live demo (0.85 sent too many correct labels to review). Full-data M4 trade-off at 0.70: ~85% of issues get a suggested label at ~91% accuracy (test).

repo_adaptation.note: Blend in a similarity-weighted vote of the repository's own labelled, earlier issues (provisional values; measured by scripts/compare_unseen_repos.py).

retrieval.scope_note: Duplicates are searched only inside the issue's own repository: 164 of 173 verified duplicateOf pairs point to the same repo. With no repository (typed issue), all collected issues are searched.
retrieval.thresholds_note: Set by the project owner after the live demo: 'possible duplicate' from 0.70 (demo repeats scored 0.52-0.89 inside one repo). 'Check by hand' from 0.55. Search is same-repository only; the false-alarm rates for these values are measured in outputs/m4_full/retrieval_pairs_same_repo.json.
